# LIPPS Studio

LIPPS Studio is the professional-services arm of the platform.

::: {.lipps-grid .two}
::: {.lipps-card}
### Research
Study design, protocols, analysis planning, sample-size strategy and methodological review.
:::

::: {.lipps-card}
### Analytics
Epidemiological analysis, statistical modelling, survey analysis, GIS, dashboards and interpretation.
:::

::: {.lipps-card}
### Training
Institutional courses and workshops in epidemiology, research methods, analysis and public-health communication.
:::

::: {.lipps-card}
### Systems
Data-quality frameworks, monitoring systems, dashboards and reproducible analytical workflows.
:::
:::

::: {.lipps-callout}
**Academic integrity**  
LIPPS can teach, mentor, review and support analysis. It should not complete assessed academic work on behalf of students.
:::
